messages:
Andrew - Recruiting: Anyone else seeing interview invites without join links this morning? A few contractors reported blank links in the calendar invite at 8:20am.
Sara L: seeing 3 reports so far. All from the new webhook handler.
Mike T: I can look. I deployed the webhook retry change last night — maybe signing header mismatch?
ATS Bot: webhook.delivery_failed id=wh_09f1 payload_status=400 attempts=1 route=generate_invite
Andrew - Recruiting: example payload one of them sent: ```json
{
  "candidate_id": "C-72a",
  "slot_id": "S-19",
  "interview_link": null,
  "attendees": ["andrew@redwood.com", "contractor@vendor.com"]
}
```
Sara L: contractor invites are created by panel-sync flow (non-admin token). Could tokens be blocked from creating join links?
Mike T: quick check of logs: the generate_invite endpoint returned 202 for admin tokens but 403 for service tokens. Looks like a permission regression with the new rate-limit middleware.
Elaine (People Ops): Oof. We sent a batch of vendor invites this week. Can we patch a workaround so interviewers/user-facing invites are reissued? The contractors need access today.
Jordan Ops: temp fix: we can run a backfill job to re-run generate_invite for all slots with null link. I'll need a list and an owner to approve.
Andrew - Recruiting: approved. Jordan, please run it for vendor scopes only. Add a cooldown so we don't hit rate limits.
Mike T: I’ll revert the middleware change on staging and add a conditional to bypass permission check for panel-sync service tokens. Deploy after code review.
Sara L: for audit, can we also append a note to the scorecard template when an invite is reissued? So interviewers know candidate got a new link.
Jordan Ops: yes — backfill will post a short note to the event and append tag "invite-reissued" to the calendar description.
ATS Bot: webhook.delivery_succeeded id=wh_09f1 attempts=2 route=generate_invite status=200
Elaine (People Ops): thanks team. Action items: Mike - PR to fix middleware, Jordan - run backfill for vendor scopes and tag invites, Andrew/Sara - monitor candidate access and update vendors. Ping me if any contractors still can't join. :thumbsup:
Andrew - Recruiting: I’ll message the affected contractors with the new links once Jordan confirms.
Mike T: pushing the PR now, ETA ~30m.
Sara L: will keep the recruiting ops tracker updated (link: https://tools.redwood/cases/3294)
Jordan Ops: starting the backfill run, logging results to #eng-oncall, tagging outcomes.
Andrew - Recruiting: thanks everyone, closing loop later today.
